snippet.title: Emberbane - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Emberbane launches on February 24, 2026.

A fast-paced 2D action Metroidvania built around elemental combat, fluid movement, and a dark mythological world.

Wishlist now on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085310/Emberbane/

Trailer Soundtrack: Ercüment Subaşı (MadRooster Game Audio Lab)
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ercument-subasi/
https://www.madrooster.co/
